note: Classification of every field of the zkSync Era Transaction struct for contracts-zksync/src/QCAAccountZkSync.sol. enumerate.py fails if a field of the pinned struct is missing here, if an evidence pattern is not found in the account source, or if a field classed not_read is read by the account or by a TransactionHelper function the account calls.

classes.commitment: an input to the commitment preimage, so any change fails the commitment lookup
classes.ceiling: the account rejects values above a bound carried in the commitment
classes.rejected: the account rejects any non-empty value
classes.protocol: fixed or checked by the protocol, not by the includer's choice
classes.not_read: read neither by the account nor by any helper it calls

paymasterInput.why: read only by processPaymasterInput, which the bootloader calls only when paymaster is non-zero, and a non-zero paymaster is rejected
